title: AI Build-Out Is Far-Reaching for U.S. Economy
title_zh: AI 擴建對美國經濟的影響既深且廣
subtitle: AI 擴建對美國經濟的影響既深且廣
author: Dow Jones Newswires

sentences.zh: 這波擴建的影響既深且廣。

sentences.en: There is spending on data-center construction, on semiconductors and computing gear, on generators, backup batteries and cooling systems.
sentences.zh: 支出涵蓋資料中心興建、半導體與運算設備，以及發電機、備用電池和冷卻系統。

sentences.en: Even snowmobile-maker Polaris said it was seeing strong demand for off-road vehicles from contractors building data centers.
sentences.zh: 就連雪地摩托車製造商 Polaris 也表示，正看到來自興建資料中心承包商的越野車強勁需求。

sentences.en: The eye-popping cost of eldercare is shifting the financial burden to some adult children who weren’t expecting to foot the bill.
sentences.zh: 高得驚人的長照費用，正把財務負擔轉嫁到一些原本沒預料到要買單的成年子女身上。

sentences.en: Mortgage rates rose significantly from July through September, leaving fewer serious shoppers competing for each home on the market.
sentences.zh: 房貸利率從 7 月到 9 月明顯上升，讓認真看房、彼此競爭同一間房子的買家變少了。

sentences.en: The number of engaged home shoppers per listing, signaling real interest beyond casual browsing, fell to 3.5 nationally in 3Q.
sentences.zh: 每個待售物件所對應的積極看房人數（代表不只是隨便瀏覽的真正興趣），在第三季降至全國 3.5 人。

sentences.en: The pullback was widespread, with engagement down from last year in 44 of the 50 largest metro areas, although major Florida markets were an exception.
sentences.zh: 這波縮手相當普遍，全美 50 個最大都會區中，有 44 個的看房熱度較去年下滑，不過佛羅里達幾個主要市場是例外。

sentences.en: Mortgage rates are still keeping many buyers on the sidelines, and as inventory continues to build, there is less competition for each home for sale.
sentences.zh: 房貸利率仍讓許多買家在場邊觀望；而且隨著待售存量持續增加，每個待售房屋面對的競爭也變少了。

sentences.en: Assuming energy prices do not rise further, “the buildup of indirect effects will maintain upward pressure on core inflation throughout 2027 and into early 2028,” he says.
sentences.zh: 他說，若能源價格不再進一步上漲，「間接效應的累積將在 2027 年全年到 2028 年初，持續對核心通膨構成上漲壓力。」

sentences.en: Investors expect the BOE to increase interest rates at least three more times by July 2027 to tackle inflation, LSEG data show.
sentences.zh: LSEG 數據顯示，投資人預期英格蘭銀行到 2027 年 7 月至少還會再升息三次，以因應通膨。

sentences.en: The BOE raised rates 25 basis points to 4.0% at the November policy meeting.
sentences.zh: 英格蘭銀行在 11 月的政策會議上，把利率上調 25 個基點至 4.0%。

sentences.en: In-kind crypto conversions provide investors with stronger protection for their digital assets and their broader financial plan, this adviser argues.
sentences.zh: 這位顧問主張，加密貨幣的實物（in-kind）轉換，能讓投資人為數位資產及更廣泛的財務規劃獲得更強的保障。

vocab.usage: far-reaching effects / consequences 深遠的影響；a far-reaching reform 影響廣泛的改革
vocab.example: The new labor law could have far-reaching effects on small firms.
vocab.example_zh: 這項新勞動法可能對小企業產生深遠影響。

vocab.usage: semiconductor industry 半導體產業；semiconductor chips 半導體晶片
vocab.example: Taiwan is a key supplier in the global semiconductor industry.
vocab.example_zh: 台灣是全球半導體產業的重要供應者。

vocab.usage: building contractors 營建承包商；an independent contractor 獨立承攬人
vocab.example: The contractor promised to finish the renovation by June.
vocab.example_zh: 承包商承諾在 6 月前完工裝修。

vocab.zh: 令人瞠目的；高得驚人的
vocab.usage: an eye-popping price / cost 高得驚人的價格／費用；eye-popping growth 令人瞠目的成長
vocab.example: The restaurant charged an eye-popping fee for a simple dinner.
vocab.example_zh: 那家餐廳一頓簡單的晚餐就開出高得驚人的價格。

vocab.usage: foot the bill for 為…買單；expect someone to foot the bill 指望某人承擔費用
vocab.example: Taxpayers will have to foot the bill for the new stadium.
vocab.example_zh: 納稅人將必須為這座新體育館買單。

vocab.usage: mortgage rates rose 房貸利率上升；a lower mortgage rate 較低的房貸利率
vocab.example: Higher mortgage rates have slowed the housing market.
vocab.example_zh: 較高的房貸利率已讓房市降溫。

vocab.usage: engaged shoppers / customers 積極參與的買家／顧客；stay engaged 保持投入；另一常見義是「已訂婚的」
vocab.example: The most engaged users open the app every day.
vocab.example_zh: 最投入的使用者每天都會打開這個應用程式。

vocab.usage: a pullback in demand 需求回撤；a market pullback 市場回檔
vocab.example: Investors bought the dip after a sharp pullback in tech stocks.
vocab.example_zh: 科技股大幅回撤後，投資人逢低買進。

vocab.usage: widespread support / concern 普遍的支持／擔憂；a widespread problem 普遍的問題
vocab.example: There is widespread concern about rising rents.
vocab.example_zh: 租金上漲引起了普遍擔憂。

vocab.usage: on the sidelines 在場邊觀望；stay on the sidelines 繼續觀望、暫不進場
vocab.example: Many investors stayed on the sidelines until the vote was over.
vocab.example_zh: 許多投資人選擇在投票結束前先在場邊觀望。

vocab.usage: housing inventory 待售房屋存量；inventory builds / rises 庫存增加
vocab.example: Stores cut prices to reduce leftover inventory.
vocab.example_zh: 商店降價以消化剩餘庫存。

vocab.usage: upward pressure on core inflation 核心通膨的上漲壓力；core inflation excludes food and energy 核心通膨不含食品和能源
vocab.example: Core inflation has been slower to come down than headline inflation.
vocab.example_zh: 核心通膨的回落速度比整體通膨更慢。

vocab.usage: maintain upward pressure on prices 持續對價格構成上漲壓力；upward pressure on wages 薪資上漲壓力
vocab.example: Strong demand is putting upward pressure on hotel prices.
vocab.example_zh: 強勁需求正對飯店價格構成上漲壓力。

vocab.usage: tackle inflation / a problem 因應通膨／處理問題；tackle climate change 因應氣候變遷
vocab.example: The city announced a new plan to tackle traffic congestion.
vocab.example_zh: 市政府宣布了一項因應交通堵塞的新計畫。

vocab.zh: 基點（一個基點等於 0.01 個百分點）
vocab.usage: raised rates 25 basis points 升息 25 個基點；often shortened to bps
vocab.example: The central bank cut rates by 50 basis points.
vocab.example_zh: 央行降息 50 個基點。

vocab.usage: in-kind conversion / contribution 實物轉換／實物出資；an in-kind donation 實物捐贈
vocab.example: They made an in-kind donation of computers to the school.
vocab.example_zh: 他們向學校捐贈了電腦作為實物捐助。

vocab.usage: securitize loans / output 把貸款／產出證券化；asset-backed securitization 資產證券化
vocab.example: The bank plans to securitize a portion of its auto loans.
vocab.example_zh: 這家銀行計畫把部分車貸證券化。

vocab.usage: private-equity backers / firms 私募股權金主／公司；a private-equity exit 私募股權退出
vocab.example: A private-equity firm bought the company last year.
vocab.example_zh: 一家私募股權公司去年買下了這家企業。

vocab.usage: wean someone off / wean economies off 讓…逐漸擺脫；wean a baby off formula 讓嬰兒漸漸不喝配方奶
vocab.example: The government wants to wean the country off imported oil.
vocab.example_zh: 政府希望讓國家逐漸擺脫對進口石油的依賴。

vocab.zh: 舉足輕重的；影響重大的
vocab.usage: a consequential decision / leader 影響重大的決定／人物；the most consequential CEO 最舉足輕重的執行長
vocab.example: It was a consequential decision for the future of the company.
vocab.example_zh: 這是一個對公司未來影響重大的決定。

vocab.usage: the government intervened 政府介入；intervene in a dispute 介入爭端
vocab.example: The referee had to intervene to stop the argument.
vocab.example_zh: 裁判必須介入，才能制止這場爭執。
